title: Knowledge graph model (noun nodes, relationship edges, properties)
keyFindings: The knowledge-graph model (noun nodes, relationship edges, properties on both) is the labeled property graph (LPG) model — the standard data model of graph databases and graph RAG (Neo4j graphdb-concepts; LlamaIndex Property Graph Index).

Astrographer's Provident graph already IS the knowledge-graph model: `fact`/`reference`/`content` nodes (astrographer.md §4.2.1), `link`/`embed` relationship edges (§4.2.2), and node/edge properties (document metadata §4.1.1; `mode`/`crossWiki` edge flags §4.2.2/§4.2.5) — already in the spec.

Zodiac's pre-graphing pipeline (zodiac.md §4.2) is the suite's clearest entity/relation extraction: crawled data is parsed into noun nodes (dependency packages), relationship edges (dependencies), and properties (metadata), then queried in graph/hybrid mode (§4.3.2) — already in the spec.

The concrete MUST work is graph-aware retrieval over the existing model: topological `reference`→`fact` resolution in Astrographer (consistent with the DAG-RAG MUST-HAVE), which enables relationship-aware, multi-hop answers.

Provenance-as-a-property is the explainability fix: Astrographer's consistency model already tracks every link/embed to its target (astrographer.md §4.2.3) and Zodiac results carry `sourceCrawlId` (zodiac.md §4.3.2) — extending RAG results with a trace path directly answers the governance/sourcing point at low cost.

Secondary consumers inherit the model indirectly: Incanter's graph is token-level (not noun-entity), Familiar's facts table is flat with provenance properties, and Solomon cross-instance ranking + Mystery topic→reference edges are PARKED until their semantics finalize.
summary: The knowledge-graph model (noun-focused nodes, relationship-focused edges, properties on both) is the labeled property graph model that graph RAG runs over. For the Auspicion Suite it is not a foreign technique: Astrographer's Provident graph (fact/reference/content nodes, link/embed edges, node/edge properties) and Zodiac's pre-graphing pipeline already implement it. The concrete MUST/SHOULD work is graph-aware retrieval over the existing model (topological reference→fact resolution) plus a provenance/trace surface on RAG results; expensive global techniques (dynamic graph query generation, cross-instance graph ranking) stay PARKED for D2 cost reasons.
